/* ================= ИГРОВОЙ ЧАТ ================= */
function toggleGameChat(force){
    const panel=document.getElementById("game-chat");
    if(!panel) return;
    const open=typeof force==="boolean" ? force : panel.style.display!=="block";
    panel.style.display=open?"block":"none";
    if(open){
        const input=document.getElementById("game-chat-input");
        if(input) input.focus();
        const list=document.getElementById("game-chat-messages");
        if(list) list.scrollTop=list.scrollHeight;
    }
}
function receiveGameChatMessage(message, name){
    const list=document.getElementById("game-chat-messages");
    if(!list || typeof message!=="string") return;
    const row=document.createElement("div");
    row.className="chat-message";
    const who=document.createElement("b");
    who.textContent=(name || "Игрок")+": ";
    const body=document.createElement("span");
    body.textContent=message.slice(0,180);
    row.appendChild(who);
    row.appendChild(body);
    list.appendChild(row);
    while(list.children.length>80) list.removeChild(list.firstChild);
    list.scrollTop=list.scrollHeight;
}
function sendGameChatMessage(event){
    if(event) event.preventDefault();
    const input=document.getElementById("game-chat-input");
    if(!input) return;
    const message=input.value.trim().slice(0,180);
    if(!message) return;
    receiveGameChatMessage(message,"Вы");
    if(connection && connection.open){
        try{connection.send({type:"chat",name:"Друг",message});}catch(e){}
    }else{
        // В одиночной игре чат остаётся доступен локально.
    }
    input.value="";
}
(function initGameChat(){
    const form=document.getElementById("game-chat-form");
    if(form) form.addEventListener("submit",sendGameChatMessage);
    const input=document.getElementById("game-chat-input");
    if(input){
        input.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
            if(e.key==="Escape"){toggleGameChat(false);e.stopPropagation();}
            e.stopPropagation();
        });
    }
})();

function setupHost(){

    const code=
        Math.floor(
            1000+
            Math.random()*9000
        ).toString();

    document.getElementById(
        "room-display"
    ).style.display="block";

    document.getElementById(
        "room-code-text"
    ).innerText=code;

    peer=
        new Peer(
            "kta7_"+code
        );

    peer.on(
        "open",
        ()=>{
            spawnBandit();
        }
    );

    peer.on(
        "connection",
        conn=>{

            connection=conn;

            otherPlayerMesh.visible=true;

            connection.on(
                "data",
                data=>{

                    if(data && data.type==="chat"){
                        receiveGameChatMessage(data.message, data.name || "Друг");
                    }

                    if(
                        data.type==="pos"
                    ){

                        otherPlayerMesh
                            .position
                            .set(
                                data.x,
                                data.y,
                                data.z
                            );

                        otherPlayerMesh
                            .rotation.y=
                            data.rotY;
                    }

                    if(
                        data.type==="hit_enemy"
                    ){

                        applyDamageToBandit(
                            data.dmg
                        );
                    }

                    if(
                        data.type==="shoot"
                    ){

                        playSound(
                            "shoot"
                        );
                    }
                }
            );
        }
    );
}

function setupClient(code){

    document.getElementById(
        "room-display"
    ).style.display="block";

    document.getElementById(
        "room-code-text"
    ).innerText=code;

    peer=new Peer();

    peer.on(
        "open",
        id=>{

            connection=
                peer.connect(
                    "kta7_"+code
                );

            connection.on(
                "open",
                ()=>{
                    otherPlayerMesh
                        .visible=true;
                }
            );

            connection.on(
                "data",
                data=>{

                    if(data && data.type==="chat"){
                        receiveGameChatMessage(data.message, data.name || "Друг");
                    }

                    if(
                        data.type==="pos"
                    ){

                        otherPlayerMesh
                            .position
                            .set(
                                data.x,
                                data.y,
                                data.z
                            );

                        otherPlayerMesh
                            .rotation.y=
                            data.rotY;
                    }

                    if(
                        data.type==="enemy_sync"
                    ){

                        banditData=
                            data.data;

                        if(
                            banditData.active&&
                            !activeBandit
                        ){

                            createBanditMesh();
                        }

                        if(
                            !banditData.active&&
                            activeBandit
                        ){

                            scene.remove(
                                activeBandit
                            );

                            activeBandit=null;
                        }
                    }

                    if(
                        data.type==="shoot"
                    ){

                        playSound(
                            "shoot"
                        );
                    }
                }
            );
        }
    );
}


/* =========================================================
   УПРАВЛЕНИЕ
========================================================= */

function checkCollision(
    x,
    z
){

    if(isFlying)
        return false;

    const pr=1.2;

    for(
        const b of collidableBoxes
    ){

        if(

            x+pr>b.minX&&
            x-pr<b.maxX&&
            z+pr>b.minZ&&
            z-pr<b.maxZ

        ){

            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

let controlsReady=false;

function setupControls(){

    if(controlsReady)
        return;

    controlsReady=true;

    document.addEventListener(
        "mousedown",
        e=>{

            if(isPaused)
                return;

            if(
                e.target.tagName==="BUTTON"||
                e.target.tagName==="INPUT"
            )
                return;

            if(
                !/Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry/i
                .test(
                    navigator.userAgent
                )
            ){

                document.body
                    .requestPointerLock()
                    .catch(()=>{});
            }

            shoot();
        }
    );


    window.addEventListener(
        "mousemove",
        e=>{

            if(isPaused)
                return;

            if(
                document.pointerLockElement===
                document.body||
                e.buttons===1
            ){

                euler.y-=
                    e.movementX*
                    .006;

                euler.x-=
                    e.movementY*
                    .006;

                euler.x=
                    Math.max(
                        -Math.PI/2,
                        Math.min(
                            Math.PI/2,
                            euler.x
                        )
                    );

                if(camera){

                    camera.quaternion
                        .setFromEuler(
                            euler
                        );
                }
            }
        }
    );


    window.addEventListener(
        "keydown",
        e=>{

            if(e.code==="Space") e.preventDefault();

            if(
                document.getElementById(
                    "chat-code-container"
                ).style.display==="block"
            ){

                if(
                    e.code==="Enter"
                ){

                    submitCheatCode();
                }

                return;
            }


            if(
                e.code==="KeyW"||
                e.code==="ArrowUp"
            )
                moveState.forward=true;

            if(
                e.code==="KeyS"||
                e.code==="ArrowDown"
            )
                moveState.backward=true;

            if(
                e.code==="KeyA"||
                e.code==="ArrowLeft"
            )
                moveState.left=true;

            if(
                e.code==="KeyD"||
                e.code==="ArrowRight"
            )
                moveState.right=true;


            if(
                e.code==="Space"&&
                !e.repeat&&
                canPlayerJump()
            ){
                velocityY=.35;
            }


            /*
                X = магазин оружия
            */

            if(
                e.code==="KeyX"&&
                gameMode==="rounds"&&
                !isPaused
            ){

                openWeaponShop();
            }


            /*
                Q = полёт
                E = скорость
            */

            if(cheatsUnlocked){

                if(
                    e.code==="KeyQ"
                ){

                    toggleFly();
                }

                if(
                    e.code==="KeyE"
                ){

                    toggleSpeed();
                }
            }

        }
    );


    window.addEventListener("blur",()=>{
        moveState.forward=moveState.backward=moveState.left=moveState.right=false;
    });

    window.addEventListener(
        "keyup",
        e=>{

            if(
                e.code==="KeyW"||
                e.code==="ArrowUp"
            )
                moveState.forward=false;

            if(
                e.code==="KeyS"||
                e.code==="ArrowDown"
            )
                moveState.backward=false;

            if(
                e.code==="KeyA"||
                e.code==="ArrowLeft"
            )
                moveState.left=false;

            if(
                e.code==="KeyD"||
                e.code==="ArrowRight"
            )
                moveState.right=false;
        }
    );


    /* ================= MOBILE ================= */

    const joyBase=
        document.getElementById(
            "joystick-base"
        );

    const joyStick=
        document.getElementById(
            "joystick-stick"
        );

    let joyTouchId=null;

    let lookTouchId=null;

    let joyOx=0;

    let joyOy=0;

    let lastLx=0;

    let lastLy=0;


    function canPlayerJump(){
        if(!camera || isPaused || isFlying) return false;
        // Земля или верх одной из платформ обби.
        if(camera.position.y <= 2.3) return true;
        if(dragonObbyCreated){
            for(const item of dragonObbyPlatforms){
                const m=item.mesh;
                const overPlatform = Math.abs(camera.position.x-m.position.x) < (item.w/2+0.25) &&
                    Math.abs(camera.position.z-m.position.z) < (item.d/2+0.25);
                if(overPlatform && Math.abs(camera.position.y-(m.position.y+2.1)) < 0.3) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    document.getElementById(
        "jump-btn"
    ).addEventListener(
        "touchstart",
        e=>{

            e.preventDefault();

            if(canPlayerJump()){
                velocityY=.35;
            }

        },
        {passive:false}
    );


    document.getElementById(
        "shoot-btn"
    ).addEventListener(
        "touchstart",
        e=>{

            e.preventDefault();

            shoot();

        },
        {passive:false}
    );


    document.addEventListener(
        "touchstart",
        e=>{

            if(isPaused)
                return;

            if(
                e.target.classList.contains(
                    "action-btn"
                )||
                e.target.classList.contains(
                    "cheat-mob-btn"
                )||
                e.target.id==="warm-btn"||
                e.target.tagName==="BUTTON"||
                e.target.tagName==="INPUT"
            )
                return;

            e.preventDefault();

            for(
                let i=0;
                i<e.changedTouches.length;
                i++
            ){

                const t=
                    e.changedTouches[i];

                if(
                    t.clientX<
                    window.innerWidth/2&&
                    joyTouchId===null
                ){

                    joyTouchId=
                        t.identifier;

                    joyOx=
                        t.clientX;

                    joyOy=
                        t.clientY;

                    joyBase.style.display=
                        "block";

                    joyBase.style.left=
                        joyOx+"px";

                    joyBase.style.top=
                        joyOy+"px";

                }else if(

                    t.clientX>=
                    window.innerWidth/2&&
                    lookTouchId===null

                ){

                    lookTouchId=
                        t.identifier;

                    lastLx=
                        t.clientX;

                    lastLy=
                        t.clientY;
                }
            }

        },
        {passive:false}
    );


    document.addEventListener(
        "touchmove",
        e=>{

            if(isPaused)
                return;

            e.preventDefault();

            for(
                let i=0;
                i<e.changedTouches.length;
                i++
            ){

                const t=
                    e.changedTouches[i];

                if(
                    t.identifier===
                    joyTouchId
                ){

                    let dx=
                        t.clientX-
                        joyOx;

                    let dy=
                        t.clientY-
                        joyOy;

                    const dist=
                        Math.sqrt(
                            dx*dx+
                            dy*dy
                        );

                    if(dist>40){

                        dx=
                            dx/dist*40;

                        dy=
                            dy/dist*40;
                    }

                    joyStick.style.transform=
                        `translate(calc(-50% + ${dx}px),calc(-50% + ${dy}px))`;

                    joyMoveX=
                        dx/40;

                    joyMoveY=
                        dy/40;
                }


                if(
                    t.identifier===
                    lookTouchId
                ){

                    euler.y-=
                        (t.clientX-lastLx)
                        *.008;

                    euler.x-=
                        (t.clientY-lastLy)
                        *.008;

                    euler.x=
                        Math.max(
                            -Math.PI/2,
                            Math.min(
                                Math.PI/2,
                                euler.x
                            )
                        );

                    if(camera){

                        camera.quaternion
                            .setFromEuler(
                                euler
                            );
                    }

                    lastLx=
                        t.clientX;

                    lastLy=
                        t.clientY;
                }
            }

        },
        {passive:false}
    );


    const endTouch=e=>{

        for(
            let i=0;
            i<e.changedTouches.length;
            i++
        ){

            const id=
                e.changedTouches[i]
                .identifier;

            if(
                id===joyTouchId
            ){

                joyTouchId=null;

                joyBase.style.display=
                    "none";

                joyMoveX=0;

                joyMoveY=0;

                joyStick.style.transform=
                    "translate(-50%,-50%)";
            }

            if(
                id===lookTouchId
            ){

                lookTouchId=null;
            }
        }
    };


    document.addEventListener(
        "touchend",
        endTouch
    );

    document.addEventListener(
        "touchcancel",
        endTouch
    );
}


/* =========================================================
   ИГРОВОЙ ЦИКЛ
========================================================= */

let joyMoveX=0;
let joyMoveY=0;

let velocityY=0;

const moveState={
    forward:false,
    backward:false,
    left:false,
    right:false
};

let euler=
    new THREE.Euler(
        0,
        0,
        0,
        "YXZ"
    );

function animate(){

    requestAnimationFrame(
        animate
    );

    if(
        !scene||
        !camera||
        !renderer
    )
        return;

    if(isPaused)
        return;

    // Килаура автоматически атакует врага рядом, даже без клика мышью.
    if(isKillAura && activeBandit && banditData.active && camera){
        const now=performance.now();
        const distance=camera.position.distanceTo(activeBandit.position);
        if(distance<=5 && now-lastAuraHit>=500){
            lastAuraHit=now;
            applyDamageToBandit(isOneHit ? banditData.hp : Math.max(25, weaponStats[currentWeapon]?.damage || 25));
        }
    }

    const dir=
        new THREE.Vector3();

    camera.getWorldDirection(
        dir
    );

    if(!isFlying){

        dir.y=0;
    }

    dir.normalize();

    const sideDir=
        new THREE.Vector3(
            -dir.z,
            0,
            dir.x
        );

    let inputX=
        (moveState.right?1:0)-
        (moveState.left?1:0)+
        joyMoveX;

    let inputZ=
        (moveState.backward?1:0)-
        (moveState.forward?1:0)+
        joyMoveY;

    const moveVector=
        new THREE.Vector3();

    moveVector.addScaledVector(
        sideDir,
        inputX
    );

    moveVector.addScaledVector(
        dir,
        -inputZ
    );

    if(
        moveVector.lengthSq()>1
    ){

        moveVector.normalize();
    }

    const currentSpeed=
        isFast
        ? .8
        : .25;

    const stepX=
        moveVector.x*
        currentSpeed;

    const stepZ=
        moveVector.z*
        currentSpeed;

    if(
        stepX!==0||
        stepZ!==0
    ){

        if(
            !checkCollision(
                camera.position.x+
                stepX,
                camera.position.z
            )
        ){

            camera.position.x+=
                stepX;
        }

        if(
            !checkCollision(
                camera.position.x,
                camera.position.z+
                stepZ
            )
        ){

            camera.position.z+=
                stepZ;
        }

        if(isFlying){

            camera.position.y+=
                moveVector.y*
                currentSpeed;
        }
    }


    if(!isFlying){

        velocityY-=.015;

        camera.position.y+=
            velocityY;

        if(camera.position.y<2.2){
            camera.position.y=2.2;
            velocityY=0;
        }
        if(velocityY<=0 && dragonObbyCreated){
            for(const item of dragonObbyPlatforms){
                const m=item.mesh;
                if(Math.abs(camera.position.x-m.position.x)<(item.w/2+0.2) &&
                   Math.abs(camera.position.z-m.position.z)<(item.d/2+0.2) &&
                   camera.position.y<=m.position.y+2.1 && camera.position.y>=m.position.y-1.0){
                    camera.position.y=m.position.y+2.1;
                    velocityY=0;
                }
            }
        }

    }else{

        velocityY=0;
    }


    checkDragonObby();
    updateBanditAI();


    if(
        connection&&
        connection.open
    ){

        connection.send({

            type:"pos",

            x:
                camera.position.x,

            y:
                camera.position.y-.7,

            z:
                camera.position.z,

            rotY:euler.y

        });
    }


    renderer.render(
        scene,
        camera
    );
}


/* =========================================================
   RESIZE
========================================================= */

window.addEventListener(
    "resize",
    ()=>{

        if(
            camera&&
            renderer
        ){

            camera.aspect=
                window.innerWidth/
                window.innerHeight;

            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

            renderer.setSize(
                window.innerWidth,
                window.innerHeight
            );
        }
    }
);

</script>


<style>
#kta7-fullscreen-btn{
  position:fixed;top:14px;left:14px;z-index:100000;
  padding:10px 14px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);
  border-radius:10px;background:rgba(20,25,35,.88);color:#fff;
  font:600 14px/1.2 Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3);backdrop-filter:blur(5px)
}
#kta7-fullscreen-btn:hover{background:rgba(55,65,85,.96);transform:translateY(-1px)}
#kta7-fullscreen-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe45c;outline-offset:3px}
@media(max-width:600px){#kta7-fullscreen-btn{top:8px;left:8px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px}}
</style>
<button id="kta7-fullscreen-btn" type="button" aria-label="Включить полный экран">⛶ Полный экран</button>
<script>
(()=>{
  const btn=document.getElementById('kta7-fullscreen-btn');
  if(!btn) return;
  const updateLabel=()=>{
    const active=!!document.fullscreenElement;
    btn.textContent=active?'⛶ Выйти из полного экрана':'⛶ Полный экран';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label',active?'Выйти из полного экрана':'Включить полный экран');
  };
  btn.addEventListener('click',async()=>{
    try{
      if(!document.fullscreenElement){
        const target=document.documentElement;
        if(target.requestFullscreen) await target.requestFullscreen();
        else if(target.webkitRequestFullscreen) target.webkitRequestFullscreen();
        else alert('Полный экран не поддерживается этим браузером. Нажми F11.');
      }else if(document.exitFullscreen){await document.exitFullscreen();}
      else if(document.webkitExitFullscreen){document.webkitExitFullscreen();}
    }catch(e){alert('Google Sites может запрещать полный экран внутри блока «Встроить код». Попробуй F11 или открой игру отдельно — одной кнопкой внутри встроенного блока это ограничение не всегда обойти.');}
    updateLabel();
  });
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',updateLabel);
  document.addEventListener('webkitfullscreenchange',updateLabel);
  updateLabel();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
